{"id":1139441993,"question_id":2,"lang":"csharp","lang_name":"C#","time":"2 years, 6 months","timestamp":1704624602,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"76 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1139441993/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Add Two Numbers","memory":"51.2 MB","code":"/**\n * Definition for singly-linked list.\n * public class ListNode {\n *     public int val;\n *     public ListNode next;\n *     public ListNode(int val=0, ListNode next=null) {\n *         this.val = val;\n *         this.next = next;\n *     }\n * }\n */\npublic class Solution {\n    public ListNode AddTwoNumbers(ListNode l1, ListNode l2) {\n        ListNode temp = new ListNode(0);\n        ListNode curr = temp;\n        int carry = 0;\n      \n        while(l1 != null || l2 != null || carry > 0)\n        {\n            int sum = 0;\n\n            if(l1 != null)\n            {\n                sum += l1.val;\n                l1 = l1.next;\n            }\n            if(l2 != null)\n            {\n                sum += l2.val;\n                l2 = l2.next;\n            }\n\n            sum += carry;\n\n            ListNode node = new ListNode(sum%10);\n            curr.next = node;\n            curr = curr.next;\n            carry = sum/10;\n        }\n\n        return temp.next;\n\n    }\n}","compare_result":"","title_slug":"add-two-numbers","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":290}
